hooks.command: for d in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.." "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/../kairos_v3"; do s="$d/kairos-foundation/scripts/session_start.sh"; [ -f "$s" ] && exec bash "$s"; done; echo "kairos_v3 is not on this device, so no glance: fetch this repo, read git log -5 and git status, and tell N. before anything else."

for d in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.." "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/../kairos_v3"; do s="$d/kairos-foundation/scripts/session_guard.py"; [ -f "$s" ] && exec python3 "$s"; done; grep -qE 'push|gh pr merge' && { echo 'Blocked: session_guard.py is not on this device, so pushes and merges are blocked.
